    TRIVIA BATTLE

    Brain Attack.

    Win the question. Pick your target.
    Find their soldier before they find yours.

    QUESTION DIFFICULTY

    Easy: familiar facts · Medium: broader knowledge · Expert: specialist questions. All use the same 7-second timer and CPU.

    Help · Privacy · Terms

    v23 · Content screening and privacy cleanup

    How to play

    • Hide one soldier and two missile defenses on your board.
    • Answer correctly before the CPU to earn strikes. Each question lasts 7 seconds.
    • Tap an enemy square to fire. Hit their soldier to win.
    • Hit a defense and its owner fires two missiles back. Missiles never trigger another retaliation.
    • Every fifth question earns 2–3 strikes and a sector clue. Three correct in a row charge one extra strike, capped at 3.

    Content review

    471 questions were conservatively excluded by a content screen for adult, graphic or abusive topics. 9675 questions remain. Screening is not a formal age rating or a full factual verification.

    Additional question data: Open Trivia Database, CC BY-SA 4.0. Imported data remains under this license. HTML entities were decoded and categories regrouped. Broken references and near-duplicates were removed in an editorial pass. Some questions include explanations checked against primary sources; the full imported bank has not been independently verified. Difficulty labels are estimates, not player-calibrated ratings.
